automated.evidence: The full current-Omarchy suite passed on the evidence commit in CI run 36738337827 (PR #15): all 16 IPC fixture scenarios, including the new tasks, ipc-2-1 and late-start scenarios; the new Panel-level Tasks harness; agenda, default-calendar and read-only details smokes; layout at 100%, 125% and 200%; 25 qmltestrunner model tests including four new task-model tests; keyboard tests; and the static, qualified-app, acceptance, SBOM, syntax and whitespace gates. The tasks and late-start scenarios were checked to fail when paging, the tasks subscription or the reconnect fix is removed.

artifacts.evidence: A local rehearsal of scripts/release/package-source.sh on the release tree (under an unsigned, never-pushed local tag) built byte-identical archives twice and passed the deterministic package-structure verifier. The signed release archive, SBOM, checksums and attestations produced by the release workflow are reverified before publication.

install_upgrade_remove.evidence: On 2026-09-30 the maintainer's live, widgetctl-managed widget on a current Omarchy laptop was upgraded from 0.1.3 to the evidence-commit runtime with omacalendar-widgetctl restore followed by install; the bar placement, center anchor and shortcut override came back unchanged. The running shell's plugin hot reload kept the previous QML (no Tasks tab) until `omarchy restart shell`; after the restart the new runtime loaded without QML errors, and the README now documents the restart. A fresh install and removal from the packaged 0.2.0 archive was not separately exercised.

transactional_restore.evidence: omacalendar-widgetctl restore was exercised twice on the maintainer's system on 2026-09-30 (0.1.2 to 0.1.3, then 0.1.3 to the candidate), each time restoring the clock, anchor and shortcut before the reinstall. The transactional installer itself is unchanged in this release.

views_edges.evidence: Against the live OmaCalendar 2.0.0 daemon and real calendar data, the Month view rendered as before and the new Tasks view appeared, showed the empty state, then listed and removed a task as it was added and completed. The headless Tasks harness checks grouping, disabled lists, the read-only guard and that the Tasks view does not clip the panel body. Day, Week and Agenda views are unchanged and were covered only by the automated suite.

keyboard.evidence: Live on the maintainer's system: `5` opened the Tasks view, `N` focused the new-task field, Return added the task, Escape left the field and Space completed the selected task. The qmltestrunner keyboard suite and the Tasks harness selection checks passed.

real_mutations.evidence: Live against the maintainer's OmaCalendar 2.0.0 daemon, two clearly labelled synthetic tasks were created through the widget in the device-only Tasks list and completed from the keyboard; tasks.list confirmed each as completed at local revision 2. No Google or CalDAV task list and no calendar event was changed. Event create/update/move/remove were not exercised live this cycle; their envelopes are unchanged and covered by the mutation-contract fixtures.

resilience.evidence: IPC fixtures cover fragmented and oversized input, malformed responses and snapshots, offline cache, daemon restart, revision gaps, sync-only changes, incompatible protocol, an IPC 2.1 daemon without tasks, and the new late-start scenario for the Quickshell 0.3.1 reconnect fix. The late-start fix was not exercised live, since the maintainer's daemon socket was already listening.

desktop_handoff.evidence: Unchanged; this release does not touch app-link execution or the meeting-link launch path. Not re-exercised this cycle.

mixed_scale_theme.evidence: The tagged current-Omarchy gate repeats layout checks at 100%, 125% and 200% scale. The live check ran on one monitor with the maintainer's current theme; physical mixed-monitor and theme combinations are not exhaustively certified, consistent with prior releases.
